sections.content: Use the pretérito perfecto for recent experiences and actions connected to the present. Form it with haber + past participle: he *aprendido*, *hemos* *conocido*, *han* *compartido*. It is useful when the experience matters now or when the time period is still connected to the present.

The participle after *haber* never changes: *hemos aprendido* stays *aprendido* whether the group is all men, all women or mixed. That fixed *-o* is different from participles used with *estar* or *ser*, which do agree — don't let those patterns bleed into this one.
